$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. ContractEnvelope<T> per FB-RAT-COM-011 (common envelope shared concept). This document IS major version 1 of the ContractEnvelope contract; the schemaVersion pattern below pins to '1.x.x' on purpose so an envelope declaring an unsupported major (e.g. '2.0.0') is a structural validation failure, operationalizing FB-RAT-COM-003's 'readers reject unknown MAJOR' rule rather than leaving it as unchecked prose.
title: ContractEnvelope
description: Generic wrapper every serialized contract in the constellation carries its payload in (FB-RAT-COM-011). schemaVersion+producerVersion per FB-RAT-COM-003; objectId per FB-RAT-COM-002; createdAtUtc/sourceTimezone/sequence per FB-RAT-COM-004; integrity per FB-RAT-COM-005; idempotencyKey per FB-RAT-COM-006. `unknownFields` exists so a decoder that meets a MINOR-newer envelope than it knows about can still round-trip the fields it does not understand instead of dropping them (FB-RAT-COM-003).

schemaVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH of this envelope+payload contract shape. This schema is major version 1: a reader validating against THIS document MUST reject any schemaVersion whose major component is not '1' (FB-RAT-COM-003) — encoded structurally via the '^1\.' pin rather than left to reader discipline. A future major-2 envelope shape is a new schema document, not a relaxed pattern here. Readers additionally MUST preserve unknown MINOR-level fields on round-trip (see `unknownFields`).

objectId.description: Globally unique stable ID for the durable object this envelope carries, independent of display name/path (FB-RAT-COM-002). Producers SHOULD use a UUIDv4 or ULID string; readers MUST NOT assume a particular format beyond non-empty.

createdAtUtc.description: UTC instant this envelope was produced (FB-RAT-COM-004). MUST be an RFC 3339 timestamp with a 'Z' or a numeric zero (or non-zero) UTC offset.

sourceTimezone.description: Optional IANA timezone name (e.g. 'Asia/Kolkata') of the originating principal's local clock, for display only (FB-RAT-COM-004). Ordering MUST NOT depend on this field — see `sequence`.

sequence.description: Optional monotonic sequence number. When present, readers MUST prefer it over createdAtUtc for ordering two envelopes from the same producer (FB-RAT-COM-004 — 'monotonic sequence preferred over wall-clock').

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-supplied key used to de-duplicate retried writes of this same logical event (FB-RAT-COM-006 — 'retries carry idempotency keys'). Null only when this envelope carries no retryable side effect (e.g. a pure read result).

integrity.description: Digest+length over the serialized `payload` bytes, when payload is treated as an integrity-checked artifact (FB-RAT-COM-005). Null is valid for envelopes whose payload is not independently integrity-checked (e.g. a live in-memory state snapshot with no canonical byte form yet).

payload.description: The contract-specific body T. This generic envelope schema deliberately leaves payload unconstrained (no type restriction) — a specific contract narrows it, typically via `allOf` + `$ref` against this envelope plus a `properties/payload/$ref` to that contract's own payload schema.

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize (e.g. from a newer MINOR of this schema). Present so a round-trip (decode → re-encode) does not silently drop data (FB-RAT-COM-003). Encoders SHOULD merge this bag back into the top-level object rather than nesting it under this key in the wire form; it is modeled as an explicit field here because JSON Schema has no native 'preserve-and-passthrough' keyword.

name.description: Stable producer identifier (module or service name), e.g. 'core-engine.workspace-kernel'.

version.description: producerVersion — the producing component's own release version (FB-RAT-COM-003), independent of schemaVersion.

instanceId.description: Optional per-install/per-run identifier, for provenance (FB-RAT-COM-008) without being personally identifying.

algorithm.description: Digest algorithm; SHA-256 or stronger only (FB-RAT-COM-005).

digestHex.description: Lowercase-hex digest of the exact bytes described by byteLength.

byteLength.description: Exact byte length of the digested content (FB-RAT-COM-005).
